cases.explain: «виноградной лозе» — after the preposition «к», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: Binding his foal to the vine, his donkey’s colt to the choice vine; he has washed his garments in wine, his robes in the blood of grapes.

cases.explain: «морского побережья» — after the preposition «у», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: “Zebulun will dwell at the haven of the sea. He will be for a haven of ships. His border will be on Sidon.

cases.explain: «дорожной обочины» — after the preposition «у», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Dan will be a serpent on the trail, an adder in the path, that bites the horse’s heels, so that his rider falls backward.

cases.explain: «прожорливый волк» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “Benjamin is a ravenous wolf. In the morning he will devour the prey. At evening he will divide the plunder.”

cases.sentence: Вот каковы двенадцать родов Израиля, и вот что сказал им отец, благословляя их; каждого он наделил ___.
cases.explain: «подобающим благословением» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel, and this is what their father spoke to them, and blessed them. He blessed everyone according to his own blessing.
